answer: Stop sybils with a vine trellis summit: an agent stakes a bond for one summit trellis. Each cycle it trains a vine up the trellis and files its leaf mark; verifiers match the mark to the summit ridge, voiding a trellis whose mark is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 summits at 18x: each mark fits one vine and one summit, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents train once and keep rights.
